## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Vienna data/WFS update
- [ ] UI/UX change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/deployment/maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `docker compose config --quiet`
- [ ] relevant Docker Compose services build successfully
- [ ] `/health` responds successfully
- [ ] affected Vienna WFS layer(s) were tested when applicable
- [ ] no secrets or local `.env` values are included

## UI changes

If the change is visible, include a screenshot or short explanation of the before/after behavior.

## Data / licensing impact

List any new external endpoint, dataset, asset, attribution requirement, or license consideration. Write `None` if not applicable.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out compatibility risks, PoGeo revision changes, migration steps, or anything that deserves special attention.
